main_text.l: illa Chronici Eusebii verba ad annum
Domini CXXXIV. Basilides Hæresiarches

l.i: in Alexandriâ commoratur, à quo Gnostici.

main_text.l: Conjectura est Viri docti nullâ solidâ ra-
tione subnixa; sed etsi daremus ad illa
verba respexisse Hieronymum, non ideò
sequetur idem esse in Alexandriâ com-
morari, & mori in Alexandriâ, Basilides
quippe Alexandriæ per aliquot annos sub
Hadriano commorari potuit, ab anno vi-
delicet Hadriani XVII. & posteà naturæ
cedere: post eum annum nusquam com-
paruit, inquit Pearsonius, Unde hoc hau-
sit? aliquem Veterum indicet qui id te-
stetur? Si ex Eusebii silentio illud infert,
frustrà est; Nam Eusebius Hæreticorum
ætatem designare solet, nullámque dein-
ceps aut admodùm raram eorum mentio-
nem facere, nisi forte dùm Scriptores Ec-
clesiasticos stilum adversus illos exercen-
tes exhibet, quod cùm non animadverte-
rit Hieronymus, verisimile est eum in ani-
mum induxisse suum Basilidem tempori-
bus Hadriani mortuum esse; quoniam Eu-
sebius observatâ semel Basilidis in Urbe
Alexandriâ commoratione, de illo peni-
tùs tacet in reliquo Chronico. Huic ex
Hieronymo desumptæ exceptioni occur-
rit Dallæus pag. 287. Baronii rationes
refellendo; sic autem occurrit: Id nescio

page.notes: Printed text on the page is all in the one paragraph, which runs from the previous page and ends with "Id nescio". The "Kk" at the foot is the gathering signature. The running head has a trailing mark after "partem" that may be a colon or period; I have written it without punctuation. The "Dallæus" reference "287." is printed with a full stop. Printed "Eusebij" was normalised to "Eusebii" under the i/j rule; the final letter is a vowel.
